## Simpson's paradox (simple explanation)

A clear introduction to one of the most counterintuitive results in statistics — when a trend that appears in grouped data reverses when the groups are combined.

## Simpson's paradox (in depth)

A more detailed look at Simpson's paradox with real-world examples, and why data aggregation can lead us to completely wrong conclusions.
